analogy.rationale: ER antagonists require ESR1/ESR2 expression, which is high only in MCF7 and low/absent in most of these lines, so the transcriptional response should be weak and largely restricted to breast cancer cells. The closest analogs are other nuclear-receptor ligands (estrogen receptor agonist, androgen receptor antagonist, progesterone receptor agonist) that share the steroid-receptor transcriptional program where expressed.
